QUOTE: NONE
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer discusses where the opt-out is enabled and that the TU resolves names consistently, but never states that a consumer defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain names while an ordinary public-header consumer sees the renamed (private_) names. It only says that without the define the name is `private_foo` and with it the name is `foo`. It frames this as a per-translation-unit switch, not as different consumers seeing different views of the same headers.
